text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Cesario—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Cesario pointed,
there was a claw crane machine filled with plushies
themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The other day, Craft gave one to me. She said she had won a duplicate.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "If we're doing it anyway, we might as well complete the whole set," she said.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could win at least one for them,
but I've never managed to win one myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see.
If that's how it is—
choice_data_list: Man, I really feel like playing a crane game right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
